question_text: You are entering a public road e.g. from a field or building site and considerably soil the road. Who is responsible for eliminating this traffic obstruction?

options.text: You, as you have caused it
The competent road-building authority
The persons living along this section of the road

correct_answers.text: You, as you have caused it

comment: If you significantly pollute a road due to leaving an unpaved area, then you, the polluter, must clean it.

question_text: What must you do to avoid endangering others by equipment or load which has fallen off your vehicle?

options.text: - remove the parts yourself
- secure the danger spot and immediately inform the road service or police
- proceed and inform the nearest municipal office

correct_answers.text: - secure the danger spot and immediately inform the road service or police

comment: You must immediately remove any objects from the roadway that have fallen down and endanger other road users. Secure the danger zone. If necessary, contact the police or road services.

question_text: Your vehicle has left a considerable amount of dirt on the carriageway, causing a risk to road traffic. What do you have to do?

options.text: - clean up the dirt without delay
- properly indicate the point of danger until the cleaning has taken place
- do nothing if the point of danger is easily recognisable

correct_answers.text: - clean up the dirt without delay
- properly indicate the point of danger until the cleaning has taken place

comment: The following road users will thank you if you eliminate immediately the pollution and the danger point to the elimination doing sufficiently marked. In an easy recognition of the danger spot doing nothing is wrong.

question_text: What do you have to do when exiting a construction site in your vehicle?

options.text: - clean the tyres and the lighting systems
- remove any stones jammed into between twin tyres
- ensure that none of the load can fall off

correct_answers.text: - clean the tyres and the lighting systems
- remove any stones jammed into between twin tyres
- ensure that none of the load can fall off

comment: When leaving a construction site you should ensure that no charge can fall down and clean the tires and lighting equipment. Also remove jammed stones between the dual tires. All three answers are correct.

question_text: How should you behave when you leave a construction site with your vehicle?

options.text: - clean the lighting equipment
- remove stones stuck between the twin tyres
- ensure that loaded bulk material is adequately covered

correct_answers.text: - remove stones stuck between the twin tyres
- ensure that loaded bulk material is adequately covered

comment: When leaving a construction site, it is important to clean the lighting equipment to ensure that you are clearly visible to other road users and that road safety is not compromised. Removing stones trapped between the twin tires prevents them from being thrown out while driving, causing damage to other vehicles or causing accidents. In addition, loaded bulk material must be adequately covered to prevent material from falling onto the road while driving and thus posing a danger to following traffic. These measures serve to protect all road users and help prevent pollution and hazards in road traffic.

question_text: What must you do to avoid soiling the roadway?

options.text: Remove loose earth from the tyres before leaving the field
Clean working equipment before leaving the field
When it rains, only use truck tractors with twin tyres

correct_answers.text: Remove loose earth from the tyres before leaving the field
Clean working equipment before leaving the field

question_text: When driving your agricultural vehicle, you could not avoid soiling the roadway. What must you do?

options.text: Take immediate measures to clean up the soiled area
Adequately mark the dangerous spot until the soilage is removed
Secure the dangerous spot by a warning triangle until the rain has washed the dirt away

correct_answers.text: Take immediate measures to clean up the soiled area
Adequately mark the dangerous spot until the soilage is removed

question_text: You have dirtied the public highway with your agricultural vehicle. This is endangering or impeding traffic. What do you have to do?

options.text: - remove such dirt without delay
- adequately indicate the dirty area until the dirt can be removed
- always notifiy the office of public order of such soiling

correct_answers.text: - adequately indicate the dirty area until the dirt can be removed

comment: Clean up the area and mark it visibly to eliminate a hazard.
